decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin. This combo allows the player to equip the colossal hammer for only one mana, enabling the equipped creature to become a massive threat. The deck includes cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga to search for and tutor the necessary combo pieces. It also includes cards like Swords to Plowshares for removal and protection cards like Sigarda's Aid and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire to ensure the combo's success. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful, explosive play.

The deck focuses on using efficient spells and creatures to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent. By utilizing cheap countermagic and powerful threats like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building a board presence. The inclusion of disruptive lands like Wasteland and versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Expressive Iteration allows for flexibility in dealing with various threats. Overall, the deck seeks to capitalize on its fast and aggressive nature to control the pace of the game and secure a victory.

The main concept of this Bomberman combo deck is to quickly assemble the Auriok Salvagers and Lion's Eye Diamond combo to generate infinite mana. The deck uses various artifacts such as Lotus Petal and Chalice of the Void to help accelerate mana production, with Karn, the Great Creator providing additional utility and disruption. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can help find key combo pieces, while Elite Spellbinder and Walking Ballista serve as backup win conditions. Urza's Saga and Den of the Bugbear provide additional utility and creature threats to supplement the combo strategy.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using efficient and cheap creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the threats. The deck aims to control the board and attack the opponent's life total quickly, utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Gurmag Angler to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to maintain card advantage and ensure consistent draws.

A white aggressive deck that focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies while deploying efficient threats. It relies on cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, Spirit of the Labyrinth, and Wasteland to slow down opponents, while using Aether Vial and Stoneforge Mystic to quickly deploy powerful creatures and equipment. Cards like Recruiter of the Guard and Flickerwisp provide additional utility and flexibility in handling various situations. The inclusion of cards like Solitude, Skyclave Apparition, and Timeless Dragon adds resilience and versatility to the deck, allowing it to adapt to different matchups.

The main concept of this Legacy deck is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to generate a large storm count and cast a lethal Grapeshot. Utilizing fast mana sources like Lion's Eye Diamond and Mox Opal, along with card draw engines like Mishra's Bauble and Riddlesmith, the deck aims to accelerate into a powerful Echo of Eons or Breakthrough combo turn. Defense Grid provides protection against counterspells, while Urza's Saga can tutor for key combo pieces. The inclusion of Vindictive Flamestoker and other value engines adds additional versatility to the deck's game plan.

The key concept of this Aggro - UR Tempo deck is to establish early board presence with low-cost aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Mercurial Spelldancer, while controlling the opponent's board with removal spells such as Snuff Out and Lightning Bolt. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, and gain card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck's mana base prioritizes mana efficiency and consistency, with a focus on protecting its dual lands with Wasteland. It aims to quickly close out games with powerful flying threats like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler.

The main concept of this UR Tempo deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland while maintaining card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration. By efficiently managing resources and tempo, this deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot and secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently cheat big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand into play using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. By using powerful ramp cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats early in the game. The inclusion of counterspells like Force of Will and Daze helps protect your combo pieces, while cards like Brainstorm and Preordain help find the necessary pieces to execute the combo. Overall, the deck is designed to win quickly through a powerful combo strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with key creatures using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting, then bring them back into play using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. Cards like Exhume and Grief also help accelerate this process, allowing for powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty to hit the battlefield early and swing the game in your favor. In addition, disruptive spells like Unmask and Thoughtseize help control the opponent's hand and disrupt their game plan. The deck aims to win quickly and decisively through strong reanimation plays.

This UR Tempo deck focuses on quickly disrupting opponents while maintaining tempo and aggression. It utilizes cards like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure while also controlling the board with cards like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will. The deck also includes cards for card advantage and card selection like Brainstorm and Ponder. The mana base is built around efficient fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells. Overall, this deck aims to win quickly through early aggression and disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining tempo. The deck utilizes efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will, along with creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Wasteland and Daze to disrupt the opponent's mana base and prevent them from executing their game plan. Overall, the deck aims to maintain control of the game and close it out quickly with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to be aggressive and maintain tempo through disruption and resource denial. The deck includes efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Delver of Secrets to quickly reduce the opponent's life total, while also running countermagic like Daze and Force of Will to disrupt their game plan. The deck also utilizes card selection and card advantage engines like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration to ensure consistency and maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler provides a strong finisher for the deck.

This deck focuses on using efficient spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent and apply pressure on the board. By utilizing cards like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, along with countermagic and burn spells, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game while dealing damage quickly. It also incorporates land disruption with cards like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The goal is to quickly establish dominance on the board and maintain pressure to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. By utilizing fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, the deck aims to play threats like Archon of Emeria and Palace Jailer ahead of schedule, while also disrupting the opponent with Elite Spellbinder and Swords to Plowshares. The deck also includes ways to generate card advantage and additional threats with cards like White Plume Adventurer and Seasoned Dungeoneer. The goal is to apply pressure and control the game tempo in order to secure a win.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting. It then uses reanimation spells such as Exhume and Reanimate to cheat these creatures into play early, overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. The combo aspect of the deck is complemented by disruptive cards like Unmask and Thoughtseize, allowing the player to disrupt the opponent's game plan while executing their own. The deck aims to quickly and efficiently set up a game-winning board state through graveyard manipulation and reanimation.
